description: Vega 6.4.0's isoweek time unit (vega/vega#4320). Dates either side of two year boundaries whose ISO weeks straddle them: 29 December 2014 is week 1 of 2015, and 3 January 2021 is week 53 of 2020. Bucketed with and without a year, with a weekday, at a step of two, and in UTC, then labelled through timeUnitSpecifier (%G W%V) and read back with isoweek().

text.signal: timeFormat(datum.at, '%Y-%m-%d %a') + ' | ' + timeFormat(datum.yw0, timeUnitSpecifier(['year', 'isoweek'])) + ' ' + (+datum.yw0) + '-' + (+datum.yw1) + ' | ' + timeFormat(datum.w0, timeUnitSpecifier(['isoweek'])) + ' ' + (+datum.w0) + ' | ' + timeFormat(datum.wd0, timeUnitSpecifier(['isoweek', 'day'])) + ' ' + (+datum.wd0) + ' | ' + (+datum.two0) + '-' + (+datum.two1) + ' | ' + utcFormat(datum.u0, timeUnitSpecifier(['year', 'isoweek', 'day'])) + ' ' + (+datum.u0) + ' | ' + isoweek(datum.at) + ' ' + utcisoweek(datum.at)

tbin.unit + ' ' + tbin.units + ' ' + tbin.step + ' ' + (+tbin.start) + ' ' + (+tbin.stop) + ' | ' + (+timeOffset('isoweek', datetime(2021, 0, 4), 2)) + ' ' + length(timeSequence('isoweek', datetime(2020, 11, 31), datetime(2021, 0, 20))) + ' ' + (+timeSequence('isoweek', datetime(2020, 11, 31), datetime(2021, 0, 20))[0]) + ' ' + (+utcOffset('isoweek', utc(2021, 0, 6), -1))
